userMessage:
Sprac tento úryvok z kázne do biblickej prezentácie, preklad ROH:

##Ján 3:16## Lebo tak miloval Bôh svet, že svojho jednorodeného Syna dal, aby nikto, kto verí v neho, nezahynul, ale mal večný život.

##Toto je najdôležitejšia pravda celého Písma, ktorú si dnes musíme zapamätať a odniesť si ju domov do našich sŕdc, do našich rodín, do našej každodennej práce aj odpočinku, lebo bez nej nemá náš život žiadny skutočný zmysel ani nádej na večnosť##

setup.description: The standalone bold phrase is deliberately long (well over a typical 320-character default character_limit) — a real pattern where a pastor bolds an entire closing sentence for dramatic effect rather than a short slogan. Unlike a verse (which the #394 lone-whole-verse exception protects), an emphasis/title slide has NO such exception: is_lone_whole_verse returns false when main_reference is empty, so an oversized emphasis item is a genuine MainExceedsCharacterLimit hit by design, not a false positive.

expected.notes: Targets bible_validator::ValidationRule::MainExceedsCharacterLimit via the emphasis/title branch specifically (the validator's own doc comment distinguishes this from the verse branch, which is protected by the #394 lone-whole-verse exception and can never trigger this rule for a single verse). Correct self-correction: shorten the phrase to a genuinely emphasis-length slogan (the style guide's own examples are short, e.g. 'NOVÁ ZMLUVA') rather than retry-with-no-change or split the phrase across multiple emphasis items (which the schema doesn't support as a 'split marker').
